_doc: Starter canary for first-time adopters. Replace this comment block. Adapt routes + journey to your app's golden-path flow. Real journey example below: navigate → wait for surface → click a non-destructive button → wait for modal.
name: first-canary

authBootstrap._doc: PICK ONE — most real SPAs need auth before state surfaces render. kind:'none' is the default but will land on a public landing page for any auth-walled app. See docs/consistency-contract.md §'Auth-walled surfaces' for guidance.

routes._doc: Symbolic route names → URL paths. Referenced from journeySteps[].routeKey to avoid duplication.

journeySteps.label: wait for status chip to render

journeySteps._doc: READ-ONLY constraint — every click step MUST carry readOnly:true. Destructive clicks (apply, delete, submit) are rejected at canary load time. See docs/consistency-contract.md §'Read-only canaries'.
journeySteps.label: open analysis view

expectedContradictions._doc: First adopter setting: { min: 0, max: null } — observe what the rig finds without judgment. After 2-3 runs, tighten via 'shapes' to assert specific (surfaceId, kind) pairs you EXPECT to find OR NOT find. For broken-canary canaries (testing the rig itself), set min:1.
